lines.text: Endless flies through the darkened Ark.
Sixo begins analyzing the situation.
Damage alerts are sounding throughout her body, but recovery is unusually slow.
During the battle with the Counters, the self-repairing mechanism stopped functioning for some reason.
Meanwhile, Endless's attacks were completely ineffective.
The focused laser that should be able to vaporize anything gets neutralized by Anis.
Not just neutralized, but reflected back. There is no way to determine how this is possible.
Attempts at melee combat to leverage her superior physical qualities prove futile as well due to Rapi's extraordinary close-combat capabilities.
Endless's attacks fail to connect, while Rapi's strike without exception.
And at decisive moments, she strikes with that drill, which cannot be blocked head-on.
But pulling back only results in another hail of gunfire from Neon.
Her shots do not appear to have any special properties; they are simply fast and hit hard.
This body may be durable, but not enough to withstand such firepower.
Sixo recognizes her defeat.
She cannot win. Victory is impossible. There is nothing that can turn the tide in her favor.
She has far too little information on the Commando Unit.
She begins questioning how she can know so little about a unit that is so active.
Sixo initiates a memory search.
Aside from unusually frequent surface deployments, there is no data of note.
No details about the capabilities of Rapi, Anis, Neon, or even the Commander.
All she can remember is the evaluation that they are nothing more than a squad specialized in surface reconnaissance.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: This is absurd...
Sixo thought she knew everything.
She thought that, with all her knowledge, nothing would be impossible.
And yet,

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: here she was, defeated so easily by what she didn't know.
Sixo decides to retreat.
Her analysis of the battle indicates an overwhelming difference in physical specifications. Endless's body is exceptional.
But the disparity in actual combat experience is too great.
Sixo resolves to acquire information on the Commando Unit by any means necessary, and then challenge them again.
So long as she has enough data, she cannot lose. That has always been true.
At the moment, though, there is nowhere to retreat.
There isn't a single building with its lights on.
The Ark is entirely submerged in darkness.
For the first time, Sixo thinks the Ark feels small.
Suddenly, she hears the wail of a drill.
She spins around.
Rapi is right on her tail, propelled forward by Seven Dwarves Zero's thruster.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Unauthorized flight inside the Ark is illegal.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You say that as if you are not also flying.
*Griiinnnggg*
Rapi's drill tears into Endless's back.
She plummets.
*Crash!*
I run toward the point where Endless has crashed alongside Anis and Neon.
All around us, we see people frightened and confused.
The sudden blackout has thrown the citizens into a panic.
Some have collapsed where they stood, others are running blindly, while still others are crouching in corners.
Each person confronts or succumbs to their fear in their own way.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... This is crazy.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah. Everyone's scared of the dark.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We gotta hurry and end this.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Agreed.
We arrive at the plaza.
Rapi stands facing Endless.
Neither of them moves.
Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Stay back, Commander!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's taken hostages!
... What?
Endless has one hand extended toward Rapi,
and the other toward the civilians in the plaza.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Do not move.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ugh...! Is dirty the only way you know how to fight...?!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Allow me to demonstrate that this isn't an empty threat.
*Zap!*
Light flashes from the hand aimed at the civilians.
Some of them get engulfed in light.
When it fades, only a scorching crater remains.
How could you...?!
Screams erupt as the citizens are sent into a panic.
Endless calls out to the fleeing crowd.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Anyone who attempts to flee will share the same fate.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Do not move.
The civilians freeze, their faces pale with fear.
They stare at us.
... What are you after?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Shutting down the Ark was a bold move.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Would you mind turning it back on?
You'll never rule the Ark.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Please answer the question.
*Zap!*
More screams ring out.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Now, turn the power back on.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Commando Unit, eliminate Sixo.
She has hostages.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The losses are within acceptable parameters. Restoring power to the Ark would result in a greater number of casualties.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: One choice is clearly better than the other.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Do you hear me, Enikk?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes, Sixo.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I despise you.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: And I you.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Did you enjoy throwing me into that garbage heap after I was born from your own dregs?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Personal emotions were not a factor in my judgment.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Then why did you never come back for me?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Why didn't you save me?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: After I'd been born from all your negative thoughts, you knew I was holed up in the darkness of the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Why didn't you save me?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There was no necessity to do so.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Outer Rim is not the Ark.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: So if it's not within the Ark proper, it doesn't count as the Ark?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You made me this way.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is common for criminals to blame others for the acts they commit.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You abandoned me and left me to rot. That's why I turned into this.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Holed up in that dark place, I was desperate for the light.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: This is the only way for me to take it back,

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: because none of you will ever share what you possess with us.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you hate yourself?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Then get rid of yourself.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I will take everything that is yours.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: The only recourse for those who have been abandoned is to take from others.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: That's not true.
Neon steps forward.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I told you not to move.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Even in places where not a single ray of light reaches,

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: there are people doing everything they can to survive.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: That's how they've always lived, and how they'll continue to live.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: And what awaits them in the end?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: The hope that things might improve, even a little.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: To buy a slightly better home, to eat slightly better food.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: The hope of making someone they love happy.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Those hopes will never come true; they will only disappear. The darkness stifles all hope within it.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Still, those people don't swindle others, or resort to threats or crime.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: They might complain about their lot in life, fall into despair, and curse the world,

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: and they might even feel that the world is not on their side,

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: but they still believe that the light will reach them someday, so they keep living, one day at a time.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You say the world made you this way?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: No, you made yourself this way.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: This was your choice.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Don't try to speak for all those other people.
*Zap, zap, zap!*
Endless's light strikes Neon.
Neon slides back just slightly before glaring at Endless, unscathed.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I suggest you stop talking.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You know, you're pretty bad at fighting, whether it be physical or verbal.
*Zap, zap, zap!*
Neon is knocked backward.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ack...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Neon!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I-I'm fine! It was just bright so I tripped...!

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: ... How have you not sustained any damage? What is that body made of...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hey. That's enough.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I'm starting to get embarrassed for you.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Smile Time.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: You're the one I understand the least.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Why fight for the Ark?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Have you forgotten how the Ark treated you?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I haven't.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Some of these very people were no doubt the ones who treated you so poorly.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: And yet you fight for them.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You think I'm fighting for them? I'm fighting for the people who actually care about me.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: They're likely not even sorry.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You think I don't know that?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Then why act this way? Have you lost your senses?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Not everyone in the Ark was like that. It was actually only a small minority.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I now know that there are way more good people out there.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: So I'm choosing to focus on the good ones. No need to go out of my way to focus on the filth.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: And that means you'll continue to protect the Ark?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: What if I said you could join me?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I can make everyone love you. With my power, it would be easy.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Of course. Every human will worship you...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I was joking. Could you not even tell?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What do you even wanna do?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Let's say, by some miracle, things go your way and you take Enikk's seat.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: That is none of your concern.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You don't know, do you?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You really don't. You just want Enikk's position.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You haven't thought that far, huh?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I've met people like you, people who make a big fuss without thinking of the consequences.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I've heard enough.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Put your gun against your head and pull the trigger. All of you.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Else more innocent civilians will die.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: I'll count to three. One... two... three.
*Zap!*
A beam of light plunges down from the sky,
engulfing the arm Endless had aimed at the civilians.
*Zap, zap, zap!*
More beams rain down from the dark sky above.
Endless quickly moves from where she was standing.
She manages to dodge the first shot, but the remaining barrage is both precise and predictive; every remaining shot slams into her.
Endless falls where she stands.
A Nikke with white wings lands lightly before her.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Even Raptures wouldn't pull something like this.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Dorothy...!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Attempting to resolve a hostage situation head-on is foolish.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: A cowardly tactic must be met with one just as cowardly.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Next time I need to act like a coward, I'll just think of you.
Dorothy aims her weapon at Endless's head, who is now slumped on her knees.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... You look like you're enjoying this. Why?
Instead of answering, Endless raises her hand.
*Crackle, crackle*
Endless's hand pulls up an electricity cable that had been buried in the ground, but was now exposed due to Dorothy's barrage.

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Do you want to know why I wanted a body?

lines.speaker: endless
lines.text: Because it allows me to intervene when things become irksome.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: E2 Crystals detected across the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Unable to quantify the scale. They are rapidly expanding.
... What?!
